name: Colorado Trail Day 18
gear: New Balance Hierro v8  Shadow Grey
description: Long hot one! Probably the best views of the whole hike. Vestal looks so enticing I need to look into climbing it. Came up on a mama moose and her pre teen. I've had at least a dozen up close and personal moose encounters but this is the first one to be mildly aggressive - mom chuffed at me so I carried on very quickly. Got a hitch from Steve who is a serious Hard Rock aficionado and his two 14 year old deaf labradors. Staying at the Avon tonight and might take the morning here in Silverton tomorrow depending on weather and vibes.
